verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a commerce platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Swell's core platform can be self-hosted. The docs describe a hosted service: functions deploy to Swell's edge locations, and apps and config are pushed to Swell stores. Self-hostable frontends or themes are only adjacent to self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
